events.question: Can frozen hard-sparse encoders induce chord roughness absent from the saved model-state geometry?
events.design: Saved response_surface_focused4954100 first-block native/locked states;16 sources,768 matched-radius paths; frozen Hume PCA/TopK/nested k8/16 seed4951000; fixed first-k PC and raw identity controls

exact_findings.conclusion: Frozen hard-sparse maps introduce substantial chord roughness in these saved first-block residual states; raw model states also have nonzero curvature.
exact_findings.ratio_definition: Ratio of source-averaged actual decoded chord RMS to source-averaged raw chord RMS, pooling the balanced frozen paths; not mean pathwise curvature ratio.

audit.independent_replay: Canonical frozen encoder+dense decoder on first path/source, all36 arms, bothprecisions; exact canonical repeats

tests.provenance: Completed preflight tests/plants; first ineffective mutant preserved in verification_failure.json and failed_plants_v1.py.

qualifications: All 24 sparse arm means exceed raw-state chord means, but individual sources and paths need not do so.
Isolated dictionary chords use off-manifold activation interpolation; actual-path chords use saved native responses at the actual input midpoint.
Identity and fixed first-k PC projection have isolated chord RMS at roundoff; adaptive signed PCA TopK is nonlinear, not fixed rank-k projection.
Support switches coincide with resolved isolated curvature; unswitched learned maps can still include ReLU nonlinearity in principle.
FP64 only changes dictionary arithmetic over saved FP32 model states; it does not establish native-model FP64 accuracy.
These compressed representations have nonzero reconstruction error and altered secant response; results do not rank semantic quality.
Source n=16 synthetic backgrounds. One dictionary seed, k8/16, first-block residual coordinates, no inferential significance claim or general monosemanticity claim.
Nested uses the frozen simplified shared-code two-prefix recipe, not a full Matryoshka reproduction.

exact_findings.next_decision: Close this saved-only comparison. Treat decoded sparse-path roughness as encoder-dependent and require raw-state, fixed-linear, support-turnover and precision controls in later interpretation; no new native/fitting/grid launch.

events.question: Can frozen hard-sparse encoders induce chord roughness absent from the saved model-state geometry?
events.design: Saved response_surface_focused4954100 first-block native/locked states;16 sources,768 matched-radius paths; frozen Hume PCA/TopK/nested k8/16 seed4951000; fixed first-k PC and raw identity controls

exact_findings.question: Do frozen hard-sparse encoders add chord roughness to saved model-state paths?
exact_findings.interpretation: Yes for these frozen first-block residual dictionaries: all hard-sparse arm means substantially exceed raw-state actual-path chord RMS. Isolated dictionary nonlinearity coincides with support changes and vanishes to roundoff without a support change. Native states still have nonzero curvature.
exact_findings.table_design: Locked normalization, k16, seed4951000. Each metric averages the same balanced phase/frequency/axis/radius paths within each of16 sources, then averages sources. Matched nominal radii .002/.005/.01, both axes. Values are chord RMS in model-native residual units, not radius-normalized curvature; absolute scales should not be compared between models.

definitions.isolated: g(h+)+g(h-)-2g((h++h-)/2); off-manifold activation interpolation, not a new native path
definitions.support_turnover: Mean token Jaccard distance between each endpoint support and activation-midpoint support, averaged over endpoints; not fraction of paths with any switch

audit.independent_replay: Canonical frozen encoder+dense decoder on first path/source, all36 arms, bothprecisions; exact canonical repeats

limitations: 16 synthetic sources; descriptive geometry, no path/token significance claim.
Saved native FP32 states; FP64 controls dictionary arithmetic only.
Adaptive signed TopK PCA is nonlinear; fixed first-k PCA is the linear control.
Nonzero reconstruction loss; no semantic-quality ranking or FFN monosemanticity claim.
Current unswitched-path comparison is conditional observational geometry; fixed-central-support same-weight intervention has not been run.

proposed_followup.design: Keep locked k16, seed4951000, both models, three hard-sparse maps, same16 sources and768 matched-radius saved paths. Freeze the16 selected indices per path/token at the saved actual-input midpoint; apply that mask at both endpoints and both midpoint definitions using identical weights and state-dependent coefficients.
contrasts: Existing hard support versus frozen central TopK support, preserving learned ReLU.
For learned maps, additionally freeze the central ReLU gate as an affine zero-isolated-chord control; PCA with fixed central support is already affine.
proposed_followup.outcomes: Paired source-level change in actual and isolated chord RMS, reconstruction/secant changes, residual ReLU switching, exact affine-null and precision checks. No outcome-based path selection.
proposed_followup.resource: Proposed1thread/2GiB/60sec saved-only cap; no fitting/native, no k/seed/depth grid.
proposed_followup.rationale: Existing first-k PC and no-switch controls strongly implicate gate switching but do not hold the learned weights and central selected units fixed on the same switching paths.

controls: Actual input-path midpoint versus off-manifold activation chord
Fixed first-k PC linear projection and raw identity
limitations: Activation interpolation is off-manifold, not a newly evaluated native path
Only saved FP32 model states; FP64 changes dictionary arithmetic, not native precision
Frozen residual dictionaries are not FFN neuron axes; no general monosemanticity claim
One seed and two fixed k values; no fitting or outcome-selected grid
Encoding nonlinearity includes hard support selection and learned ReLU; no claim of exclusively TopK causation
Resolution floors are descriptive proxies, not rigorous forward-error bounds
events.next_decision: Report completed saved-only audit. Frozen-central-support follow-up proposed only; await user instruction before any expansion.
